public_policy.primary_rule: Ingredient, nutrition, allergen, SmartLabel, or ingredient-guide/document panels are the primary photo proof for recipe history.
public_policy.secondary_rule: Product-front and package-object photos are secondary identity context unless a readable label panel is visible.
public_policy.claim_rule: No formulation claim is verified until corrected transcription and manual verification metadata exist.
public_policy.public_image_rule: Only rights-cleared public images may render inline; other sources stay as links/source receipts.
